headline: Sainsbury Lifts Profit Target to £1.065 Billion and Urges Restraint on UK Taxes
summary: J Sainsbury raised its full-year profit forecast to up to £1.065 billion despite slowing top-line sales, as Chief Executive Simon Roberts urged the UK Chancellor to avoid tax increases in the upcoming Budget.
why: Sainsbury is the UK's second-largest supermarket chain, offering insight into grocery inflation, consumer spending, and retail labor costs.

impacts.name: J Sainsbury PLC
impacts.why: Upward revision of full-year profit targets signals resilient operational execution despite slower sales growth.
